newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH SHARES JUMP 2.57 PCT ON CONTINUED BUYING.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH SHARES JUMP 2.57 PCT ON CONTINUED BUYING.

text.p: Istanbul shares jumped in early trade on Thursday morning as buying continued amid growing market expectations of a new secularist alliance to replace the ruling Islamist-led coalition government, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 .XU100 stood at 1,474 at 0758 GMT at mid-session, up 37 points, or 2.57 percent from Wednesday.
